      public static CodePointTrie.Small16 fromBinary(ByteBuffer bytes)
      Creates a trie from its binary form. Same as CodePointTrie.fromBinary(Type, ValueWidth, ByteBuffer) with CodePointTrie.Type.SMALL and CodePointTrie.ValueWidth.BITS_16.
      Parameters:
      bytes - a buffer containing the binary data of a CodePointTrie
      Returns:
      the trie
